rationale: Iter #1724 executed the 2026-05-25 ModernNCA brief: default HPs 0/7 wp but avg_ann +11.2% beats both baselines (random_topk -30.2%, rule_only -27.8%) by ~40pp, with W6 +54.9% ann / 31.7% WR / 41 trades and W7 +95.6% ann / 36.7% WR / 30 trades at thr=0.0 — the highest avg_ann of any 0/7 trainer in recent history. Every window produced trades (no flood on bear, no starvation on bull) but uniform WR collapse to 25-37% (<40% floor) indicates the soft-NN weights are too smooth. Train mode should sweep dropout↓∈[0.0,0.1] x sns_rate↓∈[0.05,0.15] (smaller candidate pool tightens neighbour weights) x d_embed↑∈[192,256] x n_blocks∈[2,3,4] x plr_sigma∈[0.5,1.5] — score sharpening is the single most valuable lift. W1 is the diagnostic window: it currently produces trades only at thr=0.0 (score collapse); the first HP combo that re-opens thr=0.3 trades on W1 with WR≥40% is the ceiling-breaker.
